resource_type.description: Required. The resource type to which the default service config will be applied.
resource_type.rationale: Resource type has no impact on the security of the resource or data contained.

location.description: Required. The GCP location for the backup vault should be on approved region.
location.rationale: Location determines physical hosting region and data residency.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: even without manual ID configuration ID will be automatically generated.
